settings.title: Due to increased costs, the Board of Directors decided at its meeting on August 12, 2026, to increase prices!

An SMS notification will also be sent to all shareholders whose contact details are available with the secretary.

settings.title: The Water Cooperative Is Switching to E-Invoicing

settings.editor: Please remember to subscribe to e-invoices! By doing so, you can avoid the €5 additional fee charged for paper invoices. Instructions for subscribing to e-invoices can be found on the reverse side of your previous invoice. If you would like to receive invoices by post (with an additional €5 fee), please contact the secretary.

settings.title: The Cooperative Has Replaced Mechanical Water Meters with Remote-Reading Meters

settings.editor: A few shareholders could not be reached, so their meters will be replaced at a later date. Meters were replaced where they were located in heated spaces to avoid any risk of freezing.
